EmailTemplate.subject: We missed you at our webinar “Set to Soar: How Consumer Travel Plans Point to a Tourism Boom"
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for registering for our webinar "Set to Soar: How Consumer Travel Plans Point to a Tourism Boom". We're sorry we missed you at the live event.
As promised, below is a link to the survey results and other resources you may find useful:
- View the Travel Survey results <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/report/how-consumer-travel-plans-point-to-a-tourism-boom/cover/]]> to learn what you should expect from eager travelers and when they will be traveling again. - Watch the webinar recording and share it with a colleague. - Request a free travel payments assessment <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/travel/payments-assessment]]> to speak to one of our experts about ways to lower your costs and improve your own payment experience.
A special thanks to our panelists for taking part:
- Dustin Figge, Homelike, CEO & Founder - Erling Aspelund, Iceland Encounter, Owner - Nicole Murray, Keefer Lake Lodge, Guest Relations Manager
Questions? Reply to this email and we'll be happy to help.
Have a great day!
